entities.summary: Diane Ducret is a Franco-Belgian writer. She has published both non-fiction historical books and novels. Much of her writing concerns the historical experiences of women, including studies of women who were closely associated with notorious dictators or gangsters. She has also written comedic fiction, and worked as a writer and host for historical television series. Diane Ducret was a journalists & chroniclers from Anderlecht (b. 1982-11-17, Anderlecht). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
